subject: CYCLE-2 TEST-RESULT: BackupReceipt/restore oracle PASS 20/20 adversarial cases + canonical Git-object attestation
body: Cycle 2 revised design PASS 20/20 deterministic/adversarial cases. It now rejects mutable refs, partial remote readback, absent verification logs, lower-tier verified-backup claims, snapshot/receipt chronology violations, canonical-role set corruption, restore-count mismatch, lineage replay/fork and predecessor-hash forgery. Independent object-id corroboration: local canonical Primary V7, Manager V5, Research V5, canonical registry and root-safe checksum manifest reproduce the exact Git blob SHA-1 IDs exposed by pinned current main. This supports GIT_OBJECT_ATTESTED for those exact objects, NOT REMOTE_BYTES_VERIFIED for the entire mirror. Full verified-backup status still requires independent remote byte readback of all declared objects and SHA-256 evidence; RESTORE_VERIFIED additionally requires clean restore against the frozen cutoff.

regression.reason: published Android baseline predates current main; process-only artifact does not alter Android/runtime invariants
